title: Connectivity issues and top banner not rendering in xdrip
body:
Hello,

The top banner where bg values are displayed is not being rendered. I am having connectivity issues. 'couldn't pair with miaomiao' despite resetting mm several times.

I thought reinstalling the app would sort it but still the same and now the app display is broken too. Have reinstalled several times now but no luck. Currently runni g the latest version, nightly build 05052020.

![15888211737438691575623970057864](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/45926936/81250520-16d71d00-9019-11ea-8cd9-18bd069d9bd3.jpg)

comments.body: Take a snapshot, instead of posting as picture, using the phone itself and post please.

If this is a serious issue and you need help, please respond.  We can always re-open.  
I'm sorry if I'm wrong.  But, it looks like you are playing a joke.  Diabetes is a serious disease.  It's no joke.
If I am wrong and you are serious, please respond.

Hello,

Its ok to close if there is no fix. Yes I had this issue for weeks and months but managed to resolve it by going back a few versions of xdrip to install on my device, since I had no replies to this issue. And i have managed to maintain connectivity by not upgrading to latest versions.

Unsure if I’ll have the same if I did upgrade though.

Thanks
